observed_truth_rule: Only independently AI-reviewed Pass B claims, with required owner adjudication resolved, may be scored as gold.

image_generation_policy.note: Permanent project restriction. Vision-description and other inference remain separate actions requiring task-specific approval.

review_policy.primary_path: Independent AI Pass A and Pass B
review_policy.second_check: A separate independent AI checks every defect, every negative and the defined ordinary-label sample.
review_policy.human_escalation: Owner review is required only for ambiguity, AI disagreement, material evidential risk, validation failures and periodic drift-audit samples.
review_policy.implementation_status: Implemented: dual independent Pass A and Pass B runners pin model mode, CLI version, prompt hashes, image hashes, raw sanitised wrappers, escalation outcomes and owner resolutions.

antigravity-builtin.note: Antigravity CLI 1.1.8 exposes generate_image but does not expose a selectable backend image-model name in successful run records. A failure message named gemini-3.1-flash-image; that diagnostic does not justify relabelling successful outputs as a pinned cohort.

gemini-omni.note: Imported 4 Aug 2026 under docs/31 Amendment B item 6. These images were generated by the owner on a subscription surface and the prompt actually used was not recorded, so exact_prompt is the frozen specification each row is judged against, not a transcript of what produced the image. The arm carries no completeness obligation (B9): views with no candidate are not_generated, because Google generation is retired and they will not be filled. Excluded from publication and from any training corpus on terms grounds.

google-consumer-2026-07-15.note: Project owner approved this bounded use because the dataset evaluates provider systems for an inventory task and does not train, fine-tune, distil, or otherwise develop model weights. Re-check before any training use or publication-scope change.

openai-eu-2026-07-15.note: Prompt and VLM evaluation only; no weight training. Re-check if use or publication scope changes.

design_change.reason: The current Antigravity CLI is the required Google generation and vision-evaluation path, but its generate_image tool does not expose a backend model name and its VLM path is an agent wrapper rather than the raw Gemini API.
design_change.effect: The six accepted legacy Nano Banana 2 Lite images remain as audited Phase 1 development evidence but are outside the immutable 200-task pilot. All 25 scored Google packets are generated afresh as Antigravity built-in / backend unknown, allowing a complete 100 Google + 100 GPT Image 2 design. All synthetic VLM runs use the pinned subscription-backed Antigravity CLI model/mode, never a Gemini API endpoint.

phase_1_prompt_comparison.result: The evidence-bounded prompt raised defect recall from 50% to 100% and removed one unsupported defect, but item recall fell 6.2 percentage points. This directional slice does not freeze a winner.
phase_1_prompt_comparison.note: Four immutable runs completed through subscription-backed Antigravity CLI. No Gemini API credential or metered endpoint was used. Wrapper token counts are recorded but are not raw API token accounting.

phase_2_pattern.scoring: generator slices and scenario/provider paired deltas implemented

blocked_by: The Antigravity subscription reported an individual quota reset in 4h11m4s with zero tokens used by the failed RP-016 attempt.
Google RP-016 C-inventory and D-condition remain pending; 14 rejected Google views also still lack their final allowed retry output.
Thirty-nine generated retries await dual independent Pass A through the same subscription path.
Seven complete packets are ready for Pass B after quota reset. Google RP-009, RP-012 and RP-018 remain excluded because their current files lack successful raw generation provenance.
No prompt or architecture winner may be frozen before complete development and validation evidence.
phase_3_execution.downstream_effect: Phase 4 sealed comparison and Phase 5 real transfer remain dependency-blocked. They have not run.

bias_check_slice.purpose: The only cross-generator control against the GPT Image 2 house-style confound. Opportunistic and unbalanced; it cannot carry a conclusion alone, and the real-transfer gate remains the primary house-style control.
